_provenance.note: Sourced from pre-qa-fix snapshot; closest pre-post-processor state available on disk. Prefer re-capture via Option B if/when a generation run is scheduled. Files dict is restricted to text under views/, routes/, server.js (binary/lockfile artifacts excluded). Mailboxes, ticketing and sample hosts were replaced with reserved .example names; venues, addresses, phone numbers and event dates were replaced with sample values for publication.

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: Hero with tagline and description, upcoming events preview cards, one featured video embed, CTA to events page

pages.title: Events
pages.purpose: Two sections: Upcoming Events (future dates ascending) and Past Events (past dates descending). Each event card shows title, date, location, image, and a Get Tickets button linking to rsvp_link. Event detail page shows full description, image, Posh ticket embed iframe (when posh_embed_url is set, height controlled by posh_embed_height), and RSVP link.

pages.title: Gallery
pages.purpose: Responsive photo grid showing all gallery photos with captions, ordered by display_order

pages.title: Videos
pages.purpose: Video cards with title, description, and embedded YouTube player, ordered by display_order

pages.title: About
pages.purpose: Ocean's story, the dome description, and the Medicine Waves mission. All content reads from site_settings keys: about_title, about_body, about_photo_url. Photo displayed with text.

pages.title: Contact
pages.purpose: Public page. Get In Touch block showing contact_email, contact_phone, contact_address from site_settings. Contact form with name, email, message fields. GET and POST both public, no login required. Form saves to contact_messages table.

pages.title: Admin Dashboard
pages.purpose: Manage events (full CRUD), photos (full CRUD), videos (full CRUD), view contact messages (read-only), edit all site_settings keys including file uploads for nav_logo_url, hero_image_url, about_photo_url

Medicine Waves is a series of small sound-journey events created and guided by Ocean Longnion.

Every experience is co-created by the community that shows up.

files.views/admin-csv-import.ejs:
← Back to Dashboard

CSV Import

Bulk import data into your app from CSV files.

<% if (typeof flash !== 'undefined' && flash) { %>
<%= flash %>
<% } %>

How It Works

1

Download a template

Pick a table below and download its CSV template. The template includes the correct column headers and 3 example rows.

2

Fill in your data

Open the CSV in a spreadsheet app (Excel, Google Sheets, etc.). Replace the example rows with your real data.

3

Upload and import

Select the target table, choose your CSV file, and click Import. Records are inserted one at a time.

Tips

  • ✓ Headers must exactly match column names — the first row of your CSV must contain the database column names, spelled and cased exactly.
  • ✓ Leave the id column out — it is auto-generated. Same for created_at, updated_at, and created_by.
  • ✓ Date format: YYYY-MM-DD — for example, 2026-01-15. Timestamps can use YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
  • ✓ Boolean values — use "true" or "false" (lowercase).
  • ✓ Max file size: 5 MB — for larger imports, split into multiple files.

Example CSV Format

Here is what a typical CSV file looks like for a "products" table:

name,description,price,status,category
Wireless Headphones,Noise-cancelling over-ear headphones,79.99,active,Electronics
Leather Notebook,Handcrafted A5 journal with lined pages,24.50,active,Stationery
Running Shoes,Lightweight trail running shoes,129.00,draft,Footwear

Available Tables

<% if (typeof tables !== 'undefined' && tables.length > 0) { %>
<% tables.forEach(function(t) { %>
<%= t %> Download Template ↓
<% }); %>
<% } else { %>

No importable tables found.

<% } %>
